sloka: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् ।तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ।। ५.३९.२५।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁ nu khalu duṣpāraṁ tariṣyanti mahodadhim ।tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau ।। 5.39.25।।।।

translations.english: "How can the army of vanaras and bears, for that matter, princes Rama and Lakshmana negotiate the ocean, which is difficult to cross?
